meta.name: infinitetalk-shopping-avatar
meta.description: 专为InfiniteTalk项目设计的小省导购员数字人带货提示词生成技能，基于四大智能体协同（提示词生成师、质量管控师、知识库运维师、跨环节适配师），生成适配Image-to-Video模式的结构化提示词（角色固定特征+动作时序+场景环境+音频匹配+光影氛围+技术约束），支持9:16竖屏、5s/幕、音频同步（Suno+chinese-wav2vec2-base）、一致性管控（角色/视觉/情绪），直接对接模型推理流程

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成带货数字人视频的结构化提示词
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在InfiniteTalk项目中批量生成数字人带货视频提示词
copy.tagline_en: Generate structured prompts for shopping avatar videos
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch generate prompts for digital human shopping videos in InfiniteTalk

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求生成小省导购员带货视频时，Claude会产出五幕分镜的结构化提示词，每幕包含角色外貌、动作时序、场景、音频、光影和技术参数，并输出参数配置表，供InfiniteTalk模型推理使用。
howto.when: 当你提出要生成小省导购员数字人带货视频，并打算用InfiniteTalk模型推理时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成小省导购员推荐云南咖啡的带货视频提示词
say.note: Claude会按五幕流程生成完整提示词

say.text: 做一个价格对比场景的带货提示词，5秒每幕
say.note: 会调用价格对比模板并匹配参数

say.text: 用InfiniteTalk生成促销活动导购视频，情绪递进
say.note: 会生成带情绪递进的分幕提示词

howto.what_en: After installation, when you ask to create a shopping video with the guide avatar, Claude produces structured prompts for five scenes, each specifying character appearance, motion timing, environment, audio, lighting, and technical parameters, plus a parameter table for InfiniteTalk inference.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a shopping video featuring the guide avatar and plan to run inference with InfiniteTalk.

say_en.text: Generate a shopping video prompt for the guide recommending Yunnan coffee.
say_en.note: Claude creates the full five-scene prompt.

say_en.text: Make a price comparison prompt with 5 seconds per scene.
say_en.note: It uses the price comparison template.

say_en.text: Create a promotion video prompt for InfiniteTalk with emotional progression.
say_en.note: It produces scene prompts with emotional build-up.
